name: LGTM (Less Gaussians, Texture More)
definition: A feed-forward framework that predicts compact 2D Gaussian primitives coupled with per-primitive texture maps, decoupling geometric complexity from rendering resolution to enable high-fidelity 4K novel view synthesis without per-scene optimization.
summary: LGTM is a feed-forward framework that decouples geometry and appearance, using compact 2D Gaussian primitives with per-primitive texture maps to enable high-fidelity 4K novel view synthesis without per-scene optimization.
